chapters.headline: The board as of Friday morning
points: Spoken edition of the Signals board; data as of 3:24 AM ET, Friday, October 23, 2026
37 items across five lanes; 20 items are new since yesterday's edition, and the newest is dated October 23
Four lanes have new items; AI, standards & research has been quiet since October 8
chapters.takeaway: Everything in this briefing traces to the snapshot on the page below it: headlines, sources, and dates only.

chapters.headline: Five new items, four dated Thursday
points: October 22: 3D Printed Fixed-Wing Drone Design and Manufacturing Guide (Automation Alley); 3M expands collaboration with Amazon, forms GSEO partnership (Manufacturing Dive)
October 22: Honeywell Technologies raises 2026 outlook due to data center, AI demand; Lockheed, Pentagon reach $7B F-35 fighter jet deal (Manufacturing Dive)
October 21: Micron announces new investment in critical minerals manufacturing (Manufacturing Dive)

chapters.headline: September totals, two new items
points: Michigan manufacturing employment: 584.8k in September 2026, down 1.7k on the month (BLS)
Unemployment 5.0% (flat on the month); labor force 4.83 million
Two new items (October 22): 3D Printed Fixed-Wing Drone Design and Manufacturing Guide, and Inalfa Roof Systems, Inc. — announced closure, Auburn Hills, 142 jobs, effective December 14, 2026
